mentions.name: Symgraph
mentions.description: Open-source plugins for Ghidra, Binary Ninja, and IDA Pro that bring LLM reasoning, autonomous agents, and semantic knowledge graphs directly into reverse engineering analysis workflows, supporting all major LLM providers including local models. A planned supporting online service will act as a cloud-native symbol store and knowledge graph where users submit files for automated reverse engineering, query shared symbols and types, and collaborate on versioned, deduplicated, multi-contributor symbols.
